findings.issue: הַפָּסַח is a common noun with the article (HTd/Ncmsa), not a proper name; Pésaj leaves the lemma untranslated and capitalizes it as a title.
נֵכָר is the noun of foreignness; extrañeza in current Spanish more often means astonishment or oddness.

notes: Y dijo Jehová a Moisés y Aarón, este estatuto de, todo hijo, no comerá, and en él match the other tokens; the verbless clause has no supplied copula.
